title: OOCGen
description: A mod that generates OOC (Only One Command) easily ingame
body:
# Forge support will be removed after 1.21.1 due to critical API removal. Use NeoForge or Fabric instead.
This mod targets to make OOC (Only One Command) generation easy ingame.
## Why you should use it
- Using this mod allows you to save and share your building, containers or command blocks easily
- You don't have to exit the game or ask for a save file or structure file to generate it
- It works well with both singleplayer and multiplayer
## When you shouldn't use it
- Trying to export a really large structure
- You're on multiplayer and not an operator
## How to use it
1. Create your selection with golden hoe (will be configurable at future, WIP) by left click and right click the corners, same as worldedit.
2. Press Enter on your keyboard and you will get the OOC result in chat.
## Contributions
You can find the source of this mod at [https://github.com/LittleSwift/OOCGen](https://github.com/LittleSwift/OOCGen). We are welcome to accept pull requests.
